dataset.description: Independent synthetic fixtures v1; not model-quality evidence

cases.question: Сколько кредитов в портфеле и какова сумма при выдаче?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM("loans"."original_amount") AS "original_amount_czk" FROM "copilot_data"."loans" AS "loans" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Покажи распределение кредитов по статусам
cases.sql: SELECT "loans"."status" AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "copilot_data"."loans" AS "loans" GROUP BY "loans"."status" ORDER BY "status" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Покажи заявки с долговой нагрузкой выше 45%
cases.sql: SELECT "applications"."application_id" AS "application_id", "applications"."account_id" AS "account_id", "applications"."payment_to_income" AS "payment_to_income", "applications"."decision" AS "decision" FROM "copilot_data"."applications" AS "applications" WHERE "applications"."payment_to_income" > 0.45 ORDER BY "payment_to_income" DESC, "application_id" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Какие заявки не прошли проверку и по каким причинам?
cases.sql: SELECT "a"."application_id" AS "application_id", "a"."account_id" AS "account_id", "r"."code" AS "code", "r"."reason" AS "reason" FROM "copilot_data"."applications" AS "a" JOIN "copilot_data"."rule_checks" AS "r" ON "a"."application_id" = "r"."application_id" WHERE "a"."decision" = 'rule_violation' AND "r"."status" = 'failed' ORDER BY "a"."application_id", "r"."code" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Покажи выдачи по месяцам
cases.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "loans"."issued_at") AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM("loans"."original_amount") AS "original_amount_czk" FROM "copilot_data"."loans" AS "loans" GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "loans"."issued_at") ORDER BY "month" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Какова доля проблемных среди завершённых кредитов?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "completed_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "loans"."status" = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "bad_count", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "loans"."status" = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "bad_share" FROM "copilot_data"."loans" AS "loans" WHERE "loans"."status" IN ('A', 'B') LIMIT 201

cases.question: Какие регионы имеют наибольшую сумму выдач?
cases.sql: SELECT "loans"."district_id" AS "district_id", SUM("loans"."original_amount") AS "original_amount_czk" FROM "copilot_data"."loans" AS "loans" GROUP BY "loans"."district_id" ORDER BY "original_amount_czk" DESC, "district_id" LIMIT 201

cases.question: Сколько заявок требует ручной проверки?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "manual_review_count" FROM "copilot_data"."applications" AS "applications" WHERE "applications"."decision" = 'manual_review' LIMIT 201

cases.question: Покажи заявки без данных о долговой нагрузке
cases.sql: SELECT "applications"."application_id" AS "application_id", "applications"."account_id" AS "account_id", "applications"."decision" AS "decision" FROM "copilot_data"."applications" AS "applications" WHERE "applications"."payment_to_income" IS NULL ORDER BY "application_id" LIMIT 201

limitations: Demo validates fixed plans and plumbing; it does not measure LLM accuracy.
Live set is small and hand-authored; results are model/version/dataset-specific.
Answer comparison ignores aliases and column order, preserves row multiplicity, rounds numbers to 6 decimals.
Truncated results fail equivalence checks. Textual semantic correctness and chart quality are not automatically judged.
